name: ExternalizedConfiguration
summary: Keeps every environment-dependent value — credentials, endpoints, limits — outside the code and reads it on startup, so that one build runs everywhere.

roles.name: ExternalizedConfiguration
roles.summary: The participant holding what was read from outside. The claim is that nothing here is compiled in, which is what lets the same artifact be promoted rather than rebuilt — and a single hard-coded fallback quietly ends that without failing anything.
